units.text: INT. TRAIN DINING CAR - EVENING
A vintage dining car on a night run through the Alps.
White linen, silver cutlery, brass lamps swaying gently.
Pine forests slide past in the dark windows.

At a corner table, three people share a quiet dinner: INSPECTOR AUGUSTIN BELLWETHER (50s, rumpled tweed, small notebook peeking from a pocket), COUNTESS ISOLDE VON RAMSAUER (60s, pearls, a lorgnette), and a young woman, PRISCA ABERNETHY-LUND (20s, secretary, gloves in her lap).
The train sways.
You were saying, Countess?
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: I was saying that I did not like the man.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: So you said.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: I said it twice. I'll say it a third time.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Countess, please.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: Do not shush me, child. He is dead. I am entitled to my opinion.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Bellwether sets down his fork.
The lamp swings.
He and Prisca both reach for the salt at once, collide, and stop.
She withdraws her hand with a nervous laugh.
He takes the salt and sprinkles it.
Miss Abernethy-Lund, you worked for Mr. Vanterpool.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: Three years.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: And you saw him last at--
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: Seven. In his compartment. He asked me for a pen.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: And you gave him one.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: Yes.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: A green one.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: Prisca stares at her gloves.
Yes.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: What of it?
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: There was no pen in the compartment, Countess.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: The train enters a tunnel.
The windows go black.
The lamps flicker.
When they return, the three are in exactly the same positions, though no one is eating.
It is a small thing. But small things are my profession.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: Inspector, are you accusing my companion?
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: I'm observing. And I would like a quiet dinner. So, if you please, we shall continue after dessert.
units.name: BELLWETHER

units.text: He picks up his fork again.
After a moment, Isolde does the same.
Prisca, pale, follows.
